log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks Grimmsnarl's Fake Out and Prankster moves. Gardevoir sets Trick Room and Mega Evolves for Pixilate Hyper Voice, hitting Annihilape and Grimmsnarl 2x. Kingambit threatens Gengar-Mega (Kowtow Cleave 2x) and Grimmsnarl (Iron Head 2x) under Trick Room. Hatterene provides backup Trick Room and Psychic (2x on Annihilape/Gengar-Mega). Three Trick Room setters ensure setup against disruption.
Avoid Gengar entirely vs hard TR core+Armor Tail. Lead Talon+Grimm for TW/screens pressure and speed control; Ape+Prim in back handle King/post-TR and Arcanine/Noivern.
decisions.notebook: Opp hard-commits TR core: Fari (Armor Tail Sitrus Relaxed TR/Psychic/HV/Protect) + Hatt (LO Magic Bounce Quiet TR/Psychic/DG/Protect) setters, Mega Gard (Quiet Gardevoirite HV/Psychic/Protect/TR), King (BG SO Brave Kowtow/Sucker/IH/Protect). Re-sets TR via Hatt post-Fari. Armor Tail blanks priority into core. H-Arcanine/Noivern still in back. Screens + Ape (save vs King/post-TR) + Prim still usable but Gengar poor into this; next preview avoid Gengar/Mega vs TR, prep for Arcanine/Noivern mix or second TR game. TW Talon key vs their speed/TW.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gardevoir)
decisions.rationale: Armor Tail blocks all foe priority: Fake Out, Gale Wings Brave Bird/Tailwind all fail. Farigiraf safely sets Trick Room. Gardevoir Mega evolves for Pixilate Fairy Hyper Voice, spreading damage. Talonflame limited to Will-O-Wisp/Protect; Grimmsnarl likely screens but can't stop TR. Hyper Voice is neutral on ally Farigiraf. Priority goes Talonflame > Gardevoir > Grimmsnarl > Farigiraf (TR last).
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads: Talonflame (Gale Wings, Focus Sash, Jolly) + Grimmsnarl (Prankster, Light Clay, Careful, no Protect). Armor Tail neutralizes their priority leads. Game plan: Farigiraf sets TR while Gardevoir Mega evolves for Pixilate Hyper Voice spam. Backline: Kingambit (Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord) and Hatterene (Life Orb, Magic Bounce) for cleanup under TR. Opponent backline: Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag), Annihilape (Leftovers, Inner Focus, Bulk Up), Primarina (Life Orb, Liquid Voice). Prioritize special attackers into Annihilape before Bulk Up. Watch for Shadow Tag trapping from Gengar-Mega.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Talonflame)
decisions.rationale: Armor Tail blanks all priority into their side, so skip Fake Out. Gale Wings TW and Prankster Screen both outspeed TR (Prankster or not) and set up before any HV. Light Screen first vs dual special HV/Psychic; clay extends. TW answers their speed and Noivern.
decisions.notebook: Opp hard-commits TR core: Fari (Armor Tail Sitrus Relaxed TR/Psychic/HV/Protect) + Hatt (LO Magic Bounce Quiet TR/Psychic/DG/Protect) setters, Mega Gard (Quiet Gardevoirite HV/Psychic/Protect/TR), King (BG SO Brave Kowtow/Sucker/IH/Protect). Re-sets TR via Hatt post-Fari. Armor Tail blanks priority into core. H-Arcanine/Noivern still in back. Screens + Ape (save vs King/post-TR) + Prim still usable; avoid Gengar/Mega vs TR. TW Talon key vs their speed/TW/Noivern. Light Clay screens strong into HV cores.

decisions.rationale: Double Hyper Voice under Trick Room. Gardevoir's Pixilate-boosted Fairy Hyper Voice is 2× SE on 36% Grimmsnarl and KOs through Light Screen even on a low roll (~51% min). Farigiraf's STAB Hyper Voice chips Talonflame and any switch-in. Spread moves ignore single Protects, maintain pressure, and preserve our TR tempo. Farigiraf (72 Spe) moves before Gardevoir (108 Spe) under TR, then foes.
decisions.notebook: Game 2. Turn 1: Farigiraf set TR; Gardevoir Mega Evolved, Hyper Voice hit Talonflame (71%) and Grimmsnarl (36%). Foes set Tailwind + Light Screen. Armor Tail blocks priority. Backline: Kingambit (Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord) and Hatterene (Life Orb, Magic Bounce). Opponent backline: Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag), Annihilape (Leftovers, Inner Focus), Primarina (Life Orb, Liquid Voice). Key threats: Shadow Tag trapping, Annihilape Bulk Up. Plan: spam special spread moves under TR; Kingambit cleans late with boosted Supreme Overlord. Prioritize special attackers into Annihilape before Bulk Up.

decisions.rationale: TR active; Talon Protects to hold sash/pos vs HV. Grimm Reflects for physical wall vs King/Arcanine later. Screens+TW intact; pivot Ape/Prim next. Avoid ArmorTail prio and HV chip.
Bring Ape into TR+screens: resists HV, threatens Fari with CC, sets up vs backline King/H-Arc. Prim weaker into this core and needs more support. Talon passes.

Farigiraf Psychic into Annihilape + Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice. Under TR, Farigiraf (72 Spe) moves first. Combined on Annihilape through Light Screen: ~77-138% — high KO chance. Gardevoir's Fairy Hyper Voice also chips Talonflame (~16-32% through LS). If Annihilape Protects, Talonflame still takes damage. Best pressure into both foes without overcommitting.
decisions.notebook: Game 2. Turn 1: Farigiraf set TR; Gardevoir Mega Evolved, Hyper Voice hit Talonflame (71%) and Grimmsnarl (36%). Foes set Tailwind + Light Screen. Turn 2: Talonflame Protected; Grimmsnarl set Reflect then fainted to double Hyper Voice; Annihilape entered. Turn 3: TR 3 turns left, LS 6, Reflect 7, Tailwind 2. Backline: Kingambit (Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord) and Hatterene (Life Orb, Magic Bounce). Opponent backline: Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag), Primarina (Life Orb), Maushold (Friend Guard). Key threats: Shadow Tag trapping, Annihilape Bulk Up/Rage Fist scaling. Plan: spam special spread moves under TR; Kingambit cleans late with boosted Supreme Overlord. Prioritize special attackers into Annihilape before Bulk Up.

decisions.rationale: TR order: Fari>Gard>Ape>Talon. BB KO range on Gard + RF 2x SE threatens both; screens blunt HV. Burn Fari less urgent than pressure Mega. Prim later.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Gardevoir Protect (+4 priority) blocks Primarina's certain Moonblast KO. Farigiraf Hyper Voice KOs 13% Talonflame through Light Screen (min 13.67%) and chips Primarina. Under TR, Farigiraf moves before Primarina, so Talonflame can't act. Result: 2v1 vs Primarina with TR still up next turn; double-target finishes the game.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 won. Series score 2-0 sweep. Opponent brought Talonflame/Grimmsnarl/Annihilape/Primarina; Gengar-Mega and Maushold left in box. TR hyper-offense overwhelmed their screens+Tailwind lead. Key lessons: Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega spread spam under TR beats fast offensive leads; Armor Tail blocks Grimmsnarl Prankster Fake Out. Kingambit and Hatterene never needed to enter.

decisions.rationale: TR order: Fari>Gard>Prim>Talon. Prim Water HV (Liquid Voice) KO-ranges 28% Gard on all rolls if it stays in; still chips Fari if Gard Protects. LS lets Prim live any double special. Talon 13% sash already spent dies to any hit before it moves, so Protect denies the free KO and preserves it for post-TW cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Opp hard-commits TR core: Fari (Armor Tail Sitrus Relaxed TR/Psychic/HV/Protect) + Hatt (LO Magic Bounce Quiet TR/Psychic/DG/Protect) setters, Mega Gard (Quiet Gardevoirite Pixilate HV/Psychic/Protect/TR), King (BG SO Brave Kowtow/Sucker/IH/Protect). Re-sets TR via Hatt post-Fari. Armor Tail blanks priority into core. H-Arcanine/Noivern still in back. Screens + Prim still usable; avoid priority into Armor Tail. TW Talon key vs their speed/TW/Noivern. Light Clay screens strong into HV cores. Prim Liquid Voice HV is Water STAB spread.

decisions.rationale: Double Hyper Voice under last TR turn. Combined spread damage guarantees Talonflame KO through Light Screen (Gardevoir Pixilate min 21.9% alone >13%). Primarina takes 23-50%. Gardevoir risks Moonblast KO (~40% chance) but even worst case leaves Farigiraf + 2 fresh backliners vs damaged Primarina. Talonflame Protect is only 50% success; if it works, Primarina still eats both hits. This maximizes consistent damage output.
decisions.notebook: Series won 2-0. TR hyper-offense with Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega spread spam proved decisive; Armor Tail neutralized Grimmsnarl Fake Out. Kingambit and Hatterene never needed to enter across both games. Key takeaway: the duo overwhelms fast offensive leads and screens under TR; preserve this pairing in future series.

decisions.rationale: Hatterene sets Trick Room to regain speed control; Kingambit chips with Iron Head. Primarina cannot OHKO Hatterene through any single move, and even if Hatterene falls, Kingambit wins the 1v1 under TR with Supreme Overlord boost. Screens stall out over time, and TR ensures we move first thereafter.
TR ends this turn; KO low Gard with BB then Liquid Voice HV. Screens blunt return HV. Talon sashless at 13% dies to most hits anyway; force progress on Mega before TR expires and they reset.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Kingambit)
decisions.rationale: Primarina is the last foe; Light Screen and Reflect are up on its side. Trick Room at -7 priority goes last, but Primarina's Moonblast (54–79% to Hatterene) and Hyper Voice (spread chip) cannot OHKO either ally. Kingambit's Iron Head is neutral into Primarina and chips through Reflect. Next turn under TR, Hatterene and Kingambit move first and double-target for the KO, securing the 2-0 series.

Talon fainted: pass. HV Water STAB hits both; LO+screens pressure Hatt/King while Reflect softens physical. Moon/Ice single-target worse vs dual threats and Magic Bounce. Protect stalls but cedes momentum under SO.

reflections.summary: Trick Room hyper offense with Farigiraf and Gardevoir-Mega overwhelmed the opponent's screens and fast offense. Armor Tail blocked Grimmsnarl's Fake Out, allowing Trick Room to go up unimpeded. Spread Hyper Voice pressure KO'd Grimmsnarl through Reflect, and a critical hit Psychic from Farigiraf removed Annihilape instantly. Even after both setters fainted to a critical Hyper Voice from Primarina, Kingambit and Hatterene cleaned up under expired Trick Room with Supreme Overlord boost.
reflections.adjustment: Preserve Farigiraf's Protect in the final turn of Trick Room when facing a strong spread attacker like Primarina, to avoid losing both setters to a critical hit and ensure a smoother transition or Trick Room reset.
reflections.notebook: Series won 2-0. Game 2 required Kingambit and Hatterene for cleanup after both setters fainted. Opponent consistently leads Grimmsnarl + Talonflame, aiming for screens and Tailwind; Armor Tail neutralizes this. Annihilape is a Bulk Up threat but was removed early. Primarina is a dangerous special spreader with Life Orb. Opponent did not bring Gengar-Mega or Maushold in either game, suggesting a hidden redirector or fast special mode. Future plan: continue Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega lead, bring Hatterene for Trick Room reset and Kingambit for late-game power; scout for Gengar-Mega or Maushold in game 3 if series continues.

reflections.summary: Lost because team preview brought Annihilape into the Psychic TR core (instantly crit-KO'd), collapsing screens pressure so Primarina's late Hyper Voices only traded the setters before Kingambit cleaned.
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Annihilape vs this TR Psychic core; keep Grimmsnarl+Primarina+Talonflame and swap the fourth for a safer answer to Fari/Hatt/King while still leveraging Light Clay screens.

Re-sets TR via Hatt post-Fari. Armor Tail blanks priority into core. H-Arcanine/Noivern still in back. Typical lead Fari+Mega Gard HV spam; King+Hatt late. Screens + Prim still usable; avoid priority into Armor Tail. TW Talon key vs their speed/TW/Noivern. Light Clay screens strong into HV cores. Prim Liquid Voice HV is Water STAB spread.
